<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-cli-reference.py - do not edit by hand. -->

Replay failed records from a sync's Dead Letter Queue.

Examples:

```
drt retry post_users                 # replay every queued record
drt retry post_users --limit 100     # replay the oldest 100
drt retry post_users --dry-run        # preview depth, send nothing
drt retry post_users --clear          # give up — empty the queue
```

## Usage

```bash
drt retry [OPTIONS] SYNC_NAME
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `SYNC_NAME` | yes | Name of the sync whose DLQ to replay. |

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--limit` | `INTEGER` |  | Only retry the oldest N queued records. |
| `--dry-run` | `BOOLEAN` |  | Show what would be retried without sending. |
| `--clear` | `BOOLEAN` |  | Discard the queue without replaying (records are unrecoverable). |
